sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.papier_in_ren: Paper scraps in the hay of the bunny run. Folded up very softly.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kaart.visitekaartje: 'Morris-Mika Property Development: we turn green into gray.' Was he here?!
sherlock.zaak.kelder.kort: Under the shed lies Grandpa Nibble's old cheese cellar, with his diary. But the last pages have been torn out!
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.0: In the bunny run lies the softest nest ever: made entirely of diary pages. Three little bunnies are asleep in it.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.1: So the evidence has... gotten cozy?
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.2: (The bunnies blink. One yawns. They think it's a very nice nest.)
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.3: As I was saying: nibblers. Let them keep it, except for one page. Read it out, Chonkson.
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.4: 'My homestead goes to whoever cares for it lovingly, for the price of one nibble. Not to anyone in a necktie.' A WILL!
sherlock.zaak.kelder.oplossing.5: So it wasn't a scam! It was Grandpa's wish! But... the very last page, with his signature, is missing.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.fout.muzikanten: Us? We've got our own bell! Ring-ring! See? Well, okay, it's a bicycle bell.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.fout.pim: I had to hand out Morris's flyers. I did draw a little flower on them, though. Secretly.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.getuige.koos.gez: Bertha the Cow has been practicing in the meadow every night for weeks. Off-key, but with feeling. She dreams of the stage, if you ask me.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.getuige.koos.hal: Welcome to The Chonky Cow! Can I get you a drink? Or a bit of gossip?
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.getuige.koos.too: Yikes. Those are chew marks. I know only one someone who eats sheet music.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.getuige.koos.waa: I was behind the bar. I'm always behind the bar. You hear everything from there.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.intro.0: Sherlock, the first village party! Music! Cake! And... the cowbell of The Chonky Cow café is gone!
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.intro.1: A party without a bell is a... party. But without a bell. Terrible.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.intro.2: Cooper from the café is all upset. Sniffer, search by the bandstand!
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.bladmuziek: The music is half eaten. The song is called 'Moo, Moo, Baby'.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.emmer_podi: Written on the bucket in chalk: 'MY STAGE'. In hoofwriting.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.folders.te: 'Coming soon: Nibble Parking!' Pete left them everywhere. But a bell?
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.hoefafdruk: Hooves! On the stage! Someone was... dancing here?
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kaart.vals_met_g: Cooper says Bertha the Cow has been practicing in the meadow every night for weeks. Off-key, but with feeling.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.kort: Just before the first village party, the bell of The Chonky Cow café has vanished!
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.0: Behind the bandstand stands Bertha the Cow, holding the bell to her snout like a microphone. She's singing. Very loudly.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.1: Moo. That's French for 'I am an artiste'.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.2: As I was saying: talent. Let her perform, Chonkson.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.3: Stop the music! Listen up, everyone: I have a BUILDING PERMIT. In one month, this will all be asphalt!
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.4: Morris accidentally knocks over the party cake. Luckily it lands on a big soft cushion.
sherlock.zaak.koeienbel.oplossing.5: A building permit for Nibble Parking... Sniffer, this is getting serious.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.fout.meelmuts: Me? I only eat flour. Raw. With a little spoon. That's healthy, right? ...Right?
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.fout.pim: Cookies? Morris won't let me have cookies. 'Cookies are not efficient,' he says. Sniff.
Last night I saw two teeny tiny flour ghosts! They walked to the playground, giggling. Ghosts don't giggle, do they?
Achoo! Sorry, I'm always covered in flour. What do you want to know, Sniffer?
Hmm, that's flour. My flour! I know every grain personally.
I was in the windmill. I'm always in the windmill. I'm the miller. It says so on my cap.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.intro.0: Sherlock, disaster! The very first cookie from the bakery has vanished! Only the baking tins are left.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.intro.1: Empty baking tins... that means the cookie is no longer in them. Write that down, Chonkson.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.intro.2: Written down! Sniffer, there's a trail of crumbs across the path. Follow it with your magnifying glass!
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kaart.handjes_in_: Teeny tiny hands in the flour
Little handprints in the flour. SO small. Who on earth has such tiny hands?
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kaart.kruimelspoo: Crumbs! They lead from the bakery to... the playground? Very small bites.
Flourcap saw two teeny tiny flour ghosts by the playground at night.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kaart.meelzak.tek: The sack says 'Flourcap'. It's open. But flour isn't cookies, is it?
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kaart.theeservies: Behind the playground: a doll's tea set, with crumbs on every little plate.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.kort: The first batch of cookies is gone. Only empty baking tins are left.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.0: The baby guhs?! But they're still so little!
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.1: Behind the playground, two baby guhs sit at a teeny tiny table, with their plushies and the whole cookie.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.2: It was a veeery important meeting, nyeg.
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.3: A tea party. As I was saying. Say, is there a little piece left?
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.4: Look, the last crumbs disappear into a crack in the floor of the old shed. When you tap it, it sounds hollow...
sherlock.zaak.kruimels.oplossing.5: Hollow! There's something UNDER the shed! I'm writing it down. With three exclamation marks.
sherlock.zaak.licht.fout.oehoe: Hoo, hoo many times do I have to say it? I GUARD the cellar. I don't throw parties in it.
sherlock.zaak.licht.fout.pim: I do sleep with a nightlight, yes. But it's a carrot. Not a candle.
sherlock.zaak.licht.getuige.bonnie.gezie: Green lights! Very small ones. Veeery many. They danced into the cellar with candles on their backs.
sherlock.zaak.licht.getuige.bonnie.hallo: Sniffer! I've seen something again. Of course. I see everything.
sherlock.zaak.licht.getuige.bonnie.toon: Oh, that sparkles just like those little lights! See, I told you so.
sherlock.zaak.licht.getuige.bonnie.waar: I was in my little bed. With one eye open, as always.
sherlock.zaak.licht.intro.0: Sherlock, there's a light flickering in Grandpa's cellar at night! And candles are vanishing from the candle maker's!
sherlock.zaak.licht.intro.1: Light in the dark... that's exactly where light belongs. Suspicious all the same.
sherlock.zaak.licht.intro.2: Sniffer, search around the cellar. And Bonnie has surely seen something again!
Melted candle wax, in teeny tiny drops. Warm, cozy, and very small.
sherlock.zaak.licht.kaart.glinsterstof.t: Green glitter dust. It glows a little. Or am I imagining that?
sherlock.zaak.licht.kaart.groene_lichtje: Bonnie saw little green lights. 'Very small ones. Veeery many,' she says.
sherlock.zaak.licht.kaart.uilenveertje_t: An owl feather on the cellar stairs
A feather from Hoo-hoo! Was she in the cellar at night?
sherlock.zaak.licht.kaart.zoemende_honin: The pot is buzzing! But there are no bees inside. Just... little lights?
sherlock.zaak.licht.kort: At night, a light flickers in Grandpa's cellar, and candles keep vanishing.
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.0: In the cellar, around a candle, sits a whole family of glowworm guhlings. They've moved in to be cozy.
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.1: As I was saying... little lights. (He's only just waking up.)
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.2: Wait... in the green light, something appears on the cellar wall! Invisible honey ink!
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.3: 'The last page lies under my oldest little tree.' (Grandpa Nibble)
sherlock.zaak.licht.oplossing.4: The oldest little tree! That's in the last overgrown patch of the village!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.fout.bouwer: Me? When I move posts, they stand straight. These are crooked. With a bow. Not my style.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.fout.morris: I didn't move anything. I never move anything myself. That's what I have... interns for.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.getuige.oehoe.gez: A little one. He pushed the posts with his little shoulder. And he was crying a bit. Hoo sad.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.getuige.oehoe.hal: Hoo, hoo. I saw it, Sniffer. Owls see everything in the dark.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.getuige.oehoe.too: Hoo... that bow. I've seen a bow like that before. On a little Mika.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.getuige.oehoe.waa: On my branch. I'm always on my branch. I put a little cushion on it.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.intro.0: Sherlock! The boundary posts have been moved! Our village has gotten two squares smaller!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.intro.1: Smaller? That's the opposite of bigger. Very bad.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.intro.2: Sniffer, walk along the edges of the plot. That's where the posts are!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.kleintje_hu: Hoo-hoo saw a little one by the posts at night. 'He was crying a bit,' she says.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.moestuinboe: A notebook full of drawings of carrots. The cover says: 'Pete's'.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.plattegrond: A map of our village. With new boundaries, in Morris's handwriting!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.schouderafd: Someone pushed against the post with their little shoulder. A veeery little shoulder.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kaart.touw_strikj: Around the post is a rope with a neat pink bow. To make it less mean?
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.kort: In the morning, the boundary posts of your plot have moved two squares inward. Your village is suddenly smaller!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.0: It was me... Morris said I had to. I tied a bow around it, so it would be less mean.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.1: All I really wanted was to grow a carrot, nyeg.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.2: Aww, Pete. Come here. You can have a little veggie garden here. A REAL one!
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.3: Really? Then I'll tell you everything. Morris wants the sale declared 'invalid'. Because 'one nibble isn't a real price,' he says.
sherlock.zaak.paaltjes.oplossing.4: As I was saying: a bow. Sniffer, we have an informant.
sherlock.zaak.rechtszaak.kort: The trial against Morris-Mika, in the courtroom of the neighboring village. Pick the right evidence and shout: OBJECTION, NYEG!
sherlock.zaak.rechtszaak.wacht: upgrade the Homestead to level 9 (and solve The Preparation)
sherlock.zaak.spook.fout.morris: Me? A ghost? Ridiculous. I'm a property developer. I develop properties. Here's my card.
sherlock.zaak.spook.fout.pim: Me? I'm scared of the dark. I sleep with a nightlight shaped like a carrot.
sherlock.zaak.spook.getuige.bouwer.gezie: At night I heard creaking. And whispering! It sounded like: 'hoo, hoo'. That's how ghosts talk, right?
sherlock.zaak.spook.getuige.bouwer.hallo: I'm not going in there anymore, nope. No way. I'm a tough builder, but I'm not crazy.
sherlock.zaak.spook.getuige.bouwer.toon: That? Brrr. Put it away. Or no, give it here. No, never mind.
sherlock.zaak.spook.getuige.bouwer.waar: I was in my site shed. With the door locked. And the curtains closed.
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.0: Sherlock! The builder won't work on the shed anymore. He says it's haunted!
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.1: Ghosts don't exist, Chonkson. Unless they do exist. Then they do.
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.2: Pardon me, pardon me, out of the way. I just need to... take some measurements. Nothing to see here. Move along.
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.3: Who was THAT? He just shoved you aside! In a shiny suit!
sherlock.zaak.spook.intro.4: A guh with a tape measure. Interesting. Sniffer, search in and around the shed. I'll keep an eye on... zzz...
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.grijs_dons.tek: Very soft gray down. Like a tiny ghost coat.
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.hoe_hoe.tekst: Bob heard whispering at night. 'It sounded like hoo, hoo,' he says.
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.luik_slotje: A hatch with a little lock
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.luik_slotje.te: A little lock with a cheese on it... Wait. Your rusty little key fits! Click!
sherlock.zaak.spook.kaart.schoenafdrukke: Enormous shoes. Shiny and polished. A Mika's! But ghosts don't wear shoes, do they?
There's a HATCH in the floor! With fluffy feathers on it. Ghosts don't have feathers, do they?
sherlock.zaak.spook.kort: At night, the shed creaks and whispers. The builder refuses to work: 'It's haunted!'
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.0: You open the hatch. In the dark, two big round eyes open.
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.1: Hoo, hoo, who gave you that little key?
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.2: The ghost is an OWL! A snuggle owl!
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.3: I'm Hoo-hoo. I was Grandpa Nibble's best friend. I've guarded this hatch for years. Anyhoo.
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.4: As I was saying: a ghost with feathers. But then who was walking around in those big shoes?
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.5: Look, a flyer in the grass: 'Coming soon: NIBBLE PARKING. 400 spaces. 0 flowers.' From Morris-Mika!
sherlock.zaak.spook.oplossing.6: The hatch stays shut for now, though. It's full of roots. Who seeks beneath the oldest, finds the newest.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.getuige.guhr: I carried out Grandpa's will exactly: one nibble, for someone who takes loving care of the homestead. And I tasted that nibble for a sec. To check it was real! It was real. Delicious, even.
Sniffer! Look at my tan! Structural report on my vacation: chonky.
On the beach! With my sombrero. But now I'm back, for the trial. How fun!
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.getuige.hend: Cock-a-doodle-doo! I didn't see a thing. But I'd love to come. Can my duckie come too?
Cock-a-doodle-doo! (Henry the Rooster stands very proudly on one leg.)
Cock-a-doodle-doo. By the pond. With my duckie. Romantic.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.getuige.oeho: Grandpa Nibble gave me the last page. 'Guard it well, Hoo-hoo,' he said. And so I did. Anyhoo.
Hoo, hoo. A trial? I'd love to testify. I'm even wearing a little bow for it.
Here. Always here. I guard things, remember?
Grandpa Nibble said it every day: 'My homestead goes to someone who'll care for it lovingly.' I'll tell the judge, sweetie.
Hello, sweetie! I'm knitting a warm little scarf for the judge. Courtrooms are always so drafty.
In the cart. I love riding along. All that bumping is so good for knitting.
Morris says one nibble isn't a real price. And that the will is fake. But that's not true! I saw it!
I'll testify for you! I'm a little scared, though. Can I bring my carrot?
I'm practicing my testimony. In my little veggie garden. The carrots are very good listeners.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.intro.0: A trial! Sniffer, we need witnesses. Everyone who knows something about Grandpa Nibble.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.intro.1: Talk to Hoo-hoo, Granny Knitguh, Pete, Henry the Rooster... and the realtor, if he ever comes back.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.intro.2: I'm back! What did I miss? A trial? How fun!
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.intro.3: He has a sunburn. And a sombrero. I'm writing it down.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.guhrri: Guhrrit carried out the will. And he knows something about that cheese nibble...
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.hendri: Henry didn't see a thing. But he'd love to come. With his duckie.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.oehoe_: Hoo-hoo guarded the last page, at Grandpa Nibble's own request.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.oma_ke: Granny Knitguh: 'Grandpa Nibble wanted to give his homestead to someone sweet. He said so every day.'
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kaart.pim_bi: Pete tells you everything about Morris's plans. Bows and all.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.kort: Morris-Mika is taking you to court. Gather testimony from everyone who knew Grandpa Nibble.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.oplossing.0: We have all the witnesses! Our case is airtight, Sniffer!
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.oplossing.1: As I was saying: airtight. Now just a level 9 Homestead, and then we're off to the judge.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.oplossing.2: I'm coming along! I'll bring my best sombrero. Trials are SO much fun.
sherlock.zaak.voorbereiding.wacht: first solve The Tin Under the Little Tree
sherlock.zaak.wol.fout.postguh: I just deliver! What's in my cart is none of my business. Even if it's knitting.
sherlock.zaak.wol.fout.schaapje: Baaaah! (The little sheep shows you all her wool is still on her. Every bit.)
sherlock.zaak.wol.fout.wolletje: What wool? I don't have any wool. Oh wait, I look after the sheep. So I do have wool. What wool?
sherlock.zaak.wol.getuige.wolletje.gezie: What wool? ...Oh! Wait. I did see a sweet granny sitting in the order cart. She said 'hello, sweetie' and just kept knitting.
sherlock.zaak.wol.getuige.wolletje.hallo: Hello! Who are you again? Oh right, the Sniffer! Or was it the baker?
sherlock.zaak.wol.getuige.wolletje.toon: Oh, how pretty! What is it? Did I make that? No? Shame.
sherlock.zaak.wol.getuige.wolletje.waar: I was with the sheep. I think. Or with the ducks. Somewhere with animals.
sherlock.zaak.wol.intro.0: Sherlock, wool is vanishing from storage! A little bit every night. Very neatly, mind you.
sherlock.zaak.wol.intro.1: Stealing neatly... that's almost sweet. Sniffer, follow the wool.
sherlock.zaak.wol.intro.2: And ask Woolly from the sheep what she knows! Though she usually forgets everything.
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.breinaalden.teks: Two knitting needles! With a pink pom-pom on them. Someone's been knitting up a storm.
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.krullerig_regelt: An order letter with an extra line
At the bottom of the order, in curly handwriting: 'And a little wool, sweetie.'
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.schapenwol_hek.t: A tuft of wool on the fence. The little sheep looks very innocent. TOO innocent?
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.welke_wol.tekst: Woolly can't remember anything about wool. But she does remember a granny in a cart...
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.wolspoor: A strand of wool across the meadow
sherlock.zaak.wol.kaart.wolspoor.tekst: A thread of wool, all the way from storage to the cart square. Who walks wool over to the carts?
sherlock.zaak.wol.kort: Every night, a little bit of wool vanishes from storage. Very neatly, mind you.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.0: A granny? In the order cart?
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.1: Out of the neighboring village's cart climbs Granny Knitguh, with a scarf at least twenty meters long.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.2: I didn't steal it, sweetie, I borrowed it in advance.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.3: It's a giant scarf for the village party. For the bandstand! Or for a very long guh.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.4: You know, I knew Grandpa Nibble. He gave everything away for a nibble. He always said: a homestead is only worth something if someone loves it.
sherlock.zaak.wol.oplossing.5: As I was saying: knitting. Chonkson, write this down: Grandpa Nibble. That name again.
sherlock.zaak.wol.wacht: build a Weaving Mill and deliver 10 orders
